### Universe screen (commodities)

3 assets, 1990-01-02 → 2026-08-25; 1 pairs pass the correlation prefilter (≥ 0.3); 1 of them reject the Engle-Granger null at 5%. With 3 candidate pairs, ≈ 0 would pass at 5% by pure chance (Clegg 2014), so this screen is *descriptive*: performance claims come only from the walk-forward section below.

|           |   corr |   eg_pvalue |   beta |   half_life |   hurst |    n_obs |
|:----------|-------:|------------:|-------:|------------:|--------:|---------:|
| WTI/BRENT |  0.638 |       0.000 |  0.906 |       8.878 |   0.208 | 9119.000 |
